test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Ranga and Raju together can complete a task in 6 days. If Ranga alone can complete the same task in 18 days, then how many days will Raju take to complete the task?
solution:
**Given:**

Ranga and Raju together can complete a task in 6 days.

Ranga alone can complete the same task in 18 days.

**Formula used:**

Work rate of Ranga and Raju together = Work rate of Ranga + Work rate of Raju

Work rate = 1 / Number of days

**Calculation:**

Work rate of Ranga and Raju together = 1/6

Work rate of Ranga = 1/18

⇒ 1/6 = 1/18 + 1/Raju

⇒ 1/Raju = 1/6 - 1/18

⇒ 1/Raju = 3/18 - 1/18

⇒ 1/Raju = 2/18

⇒ 1/Raju = 1/9

⇒ Raju = 9 days

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
